notes: How each lead is released to partners. A lead keeps the policy it was made with. 'default' applies to every category unless 'categories' overrides some of its values. max_providers caps what a customer can choose (1 to 3); first_wave partners are offered the lead at once, wave_size more every wave_hours while it has room, and it expires after expires_after_days. The consent text tells customers 14 days: change both together.
